title: BlazeyChat
description: A lightweight and customizable chat plugin.
body:
# Features
- Per-World Chat – Enable or disable chat on a per-world basis.
  
- Shout Messages – Send shout messages with unique sounds and highlighted colors.
  
- ChatSpy – Monitor other players messages for admins, making moderation easy.
  
- Private Messaging (PM) – Send private messages with clickable components and quick reply functionality, accompanied by sounds and notifications.
  
- Reply System – Quickly reply to private messages using an action bar and confirmation/error sounds.
  
- Ignore System – Add or remove players from the ignore list, including a global ignore mode.
  
- Group Formats – Display chat messages differently based on player groups (Owner, Admin, Member).
  
- Chat Filtering – Replace or censor inappropriate words with warnings or block messages entirely.
  
- MiniMessage Support – Use advanced formatting like colors, gradients, hover, and click actions.
  
- PlaceholderAPI Support – Fully integrate with PlaceholderAPI to dynamically show player stats, ranks, worlds, or any custom placeholder inside chat messages.
  
- Sound Effects – Play custom sounds for messages, enabling/disabling features, or receiving PMs.
  
- Easy Reload – Reload all configurations or specific sections with colorful confirmation messages.
# Upcoming Features
- Enhanced Chat Filter – Advanced filtering that detects inappropriate words even if players use different fonts, Unicode characters, or text tricks.
  
- In-Game Ads for Players – Display server announcements, events, or custom messages directly in players’ chat.
- Player Settings & Database – Each player can customize personal chat settings, which are saved in a database for persistent preferences.
  
- Advanced Chat Management – Commands like /clear, /mute, /unmute, and other moderation tools.
# Commands
- /blazeychat (alias: /bc) – Main plugin command.

- /chatspy – Toggle chat spy mode to see other players’ messages.

- /shout – Send a message to all players.

- /msg (alias: /tell) – Send a private message to another player.

- /reply (alias: /r) – Reply to your current reply target.

- /ignore – Manage ignored players; add, remove, clear, or toggle global ignore.

# Support

Got questions or need support? Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/Kew8x2x2XH), we'll be happy to help you there!

BlazeyChat is currently in BETA some features may be incomplete or behave unexpectedly.
